items.question: What makes information Confidential Information under the Northbridge NDA?
items.answer:
Under the Northbridge NDA, Confidential Information is defined as all information disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential [1].

This definition excludes information that the Recipient can show (a) is or becomes public other than through a breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it before disclosure; (c) is independently developed without use of the Discloser's information [1].
